mechanics.claim: Vladimir cannot use basic attacks or abilities during Sanguine Pool, but can still move.
mechanics.quote: '''Vladimir''' cannot use basic attacks nor abilities during Sanguine Pool, but he can still move.

mechanics.claim: If Tides of Blood is charging when Sanguine Pool is cast, Tides of Blood may still be recast (its automatic release is not blocked by the pool's action lock).
mechanics.quote: If {{ai|Tides of Blood|Vladimir}} is charging at the time of Sanguine Pool's activation, that ability may still be recast.

mechanics.claim: The first damage tick lands immediately on cast, and the last real tick lands 0.5 seconds before Vladimir becomes targetable again (i.e. ticks land at 0, 0.5, 1.0 and 1.5s into the 2s duration).
mechanics.quote: The first tick damages immediately so the final one occurs {{fd|0.5}} seconds before '''Vladimir''' becomes targetable again.

mechanics.claim: There is an extra tick for 0 damage when Vladimir becomes targetable again (a 5th tick event at the 2s mark that deals no damage but still triggers the same spell effects as the normal ticks).
mechanics.quote: There is an extra damage tick for [[Damage#0_Damage_Instances|0 damage]] when '''Vladimir''' becomes targetable again, triggering the same spell effects as the normal ticks (except those which require damage greater than 0 being dealt).
